title: What I Learned from Living in a Rural Cottage - how I live a quiet peaceful life
en: About a year and a half ago, I quit my job, moved to the countryside, and started a new life. Since then, I've learned quite a few lessons on how to cultivate a feeling of abundance while living simply. I grew up moving quite a bit. I lived in multiple different countries and traveled to even more. When I moved here without any plans to move or travel again in the future, it was a cathartic experience

in which I had to redefine what it was to live a meaningful life. True fulfillment doesn't come from the acquisition of material things, nor is it acquired through traveling, visiting new places, and constantly having new exciting experiences. It's a little more complicated than

that, I find. It's part of the life journey in which we continue to discover what it is that makes us happy. There is no easy cure for sadness. Instead, I find that to cultivate joy, you must treat it like a seed. You must take care of it and let it grow and watch over it. And sometimes it doesn't produce the abundance that you were hoping for. But with time, maybe next year, it will. The key is to know that things don't

ever stay the same for long. The seasons change and so will you. It's impossible to predict where your life will be in the future. I could have never predicted that I would be here. City life was overwhelming to my more sensitive, quiet spirit and I longed to move to the countryside.

It wasn't until I came here that I realized how crucial one's environment is to their creativity and their mental health. Living in a rural area did not solve my lack of fulfillment, but it did create a foundation in which I could start to build up my courage to live my life how I wanted instead of comparing it to that of others. I'd never realized how oppressing it was to live by someone else's standards
until I came here. Over time, I got back in touch with what it is that makes me truly happy.

The day-to-day experiences and joys of simple living. I no longer needed to travel or to acquire things in order to feel as if my life was a success. Instead, the sweet smell of calendula tea was enough to make my day just about perfect. For example, I take care of young children as my primary job and spending time with them and

experiencing the world through their eyes constantly reminds me to change my perspective and see the little moments of life as what is truly meaningful and what is truly living. I am constantly surprised how my new lifestyle ignites my creativity. Not only do I enjoy painting and reading and writing, but I am trying all types of new skills and crafts.

While we often covet the ability to travel the world at a whim, I find that there is long-lasting fulfillment from learning new skills and experimenting with new ideas. I hope this video brought you some peaceful thoughts. I'm not offering solutions to anyone's difficulties. I'm just simply sharing the little things that I've learned through living in a rural area on how to cultivate a feeling of abundance in a society that often focuses on scarcity
and negativity. There is so much joy to be had in this world. And while we can recognize the darkness, we must make sure to also encourage the light in our own hearts.
zh: 大约一年半前，我辞去了工作，搬到农村，开始了新的生活。从那时起，我学到了很多关于如何在简单生活的同时培养丰富感的教训。我从小就经常搬家。我住在多个不同的国家，并去过更多国家。当我搬到这里，没有任何计划在未来再次搬家或旅行时，这是一次宣泄的经历
我必须重新定义什么是有意义的生活。真正的满足感不是来自于物质的获取，也不是通过旅行、参观新的地方和不断获得新的令人兴奋的经历来获得的。这比稍微复杂一点
我发现。这是人生旅程的一部分，我们在其中不断发现是什么让我们快乐。悲伤没有简单的治愈方法。相反，我发现要培养快乐，你必须像对待种子一样对待它。你必须照顾它，让它成长并照顾它。有时它并不能产生你所希望的丰富。但随着时间的推移，也许明年，就会的。关键是要知道事情并不
永远保持不变。季节在变，你也会变。无法预测你未来的生活会怎样。我从来没有预料到我会在这里。城市生活让我敏感、安静的精神难以承受，我渴望搬到乡村去。
直到我来到这里，我才意识到环境对他们的创造力和心理健康有多么重要。生活在农村并不能解决我缺乏成就感的问题，但它确实为我奠定了基础，让我可以开始鼓起勇气按照自己想要的方式生活，而不是与其他人进行比较。我从来没有意识到按照别人的标准生活是多么的压抑
直到我来到这里。随着时间的推移，我重新认识到什么让我真正快乐。
简单生活的日常体验和乐趣。我不再需要旅行或获取东西来感觉我的生活是成功的。相反，金盏花茶的甜味足以让我的一天变得完美。例如，我把照顾幼儿作为我的主要工作，并花时间和他们在一起
通过他们的眼睛体验世界不断提醒我改变视角，将生活中的点点滴滴视为真正有意义、真正活着的东西。我总是对我的新生活方式如何激发我的创造力感到惊讶。我不仅喜欢绘画、阅读和写作，而且还在尝试各种新技能和工艺。
虽然我们经常渴望能够随心所欲地环游世界，但我发现学习新技能和尝试新想法可以带来持久的满足感。我希望这个视频能给你带来一些平静的想法。我不会为任何人的困难提供解决方案。我只是简单地分享我在农村生活中学到的一些小事情，如何在一个经常关注稀缺的社会中培养一种丰富的感觉
和消极情绪。这个世界上有太多的快乐。虽然我们可以认识到黑暗，但我们也必须确保鼓励自己心中的光明。
